questions.question: What was Charlemagne's role from 800?

questions.question: Who was Charlemagne's father?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states Charlemagne was the eldest son of Pepin the Short.
Incorrect. Carloman I was his brother, not his father.

questions.question: In what year did Charlemagne become sole ruler of the Franks?

questions.question: Who crowned Charlemagne emperor in Rome in 800?

questions.question: Which group did Charlemagne remove from power in northern Italy in 774?

questions.question: Where was Charlemagne buried after his death in 814?

Incorrect. Rome is where he was crowned, not buried.

questions.question: Which caliph did Charlemagne send envoys to in the 790s?

questions.question: What has Charlemagne been called by many historians due to his influence?
